700 alagna 'unconnected' MW. [Cf. aláglam 'disconnectedly, stammeringly' ŚBr.: lagna -] Pa. alagga - 'not joined'; K. alogᵘ 'unsuitably'; S. alag̠u , °g̠o 'separate' (- l - after lag̠o ), P. alagg , Ku. alag ,
N. alag , °gga , A. ālag , °gā , B. ālag , ālgā , Or. alaga , °gā ;
H. alag , algā 'separate', argāī f. 'separation'; OMarw. alago 'separate'; G. aḷgũ 'not touching', n. 'menstruation'; M. alag 'separate', adv. 'without touching,
smoothly' (with - l - after lāgṇẽ ), aḷag 'properly'. alágla- see alagna -.
